INDEPENDENT RE-REVIEW — ACCEPT 8b36e32d77fe692a5b38b974177723bb047134db. The sole block is closed with the minimal safe shape requested.

Amendment delta from 1535b50 is exactly two paths: metrics.scala adds a total public fold that carries all three branches; a new test lives outside the bench package at storymodel4s.consumer. Observed construction remains private and MetricObservation.observed remains the only finite-value entry point, so NaN/Infinity still become Missing(NotFinite). The fold does not offer an Option-shaped conflation and forces callers to supply handlers for Ineligible, observed value, and missing reason.

Independent exact-SHA evidence: I fetched 8b36e32 into the prior isolated normal clone, verified the scoring, aggregation, leakage, and original scientific tests are byte-identical to the reviewed 1535b50 tree, and ran the external-package suite: 2/2 green with observed 0.5 retrievable and non-finite input still typed missing. The test is load-bearing by direct literal comparison; the author separately reports the Observed-to-0.0 fold mutation red. Combined with my prior exact 47/47 court and independently reproduced false-1.0 renormalization mutant, the candidate is ACCEPTED with no remaining finding. ADR 0003 applicability is satisfied as previously reviewed; codec/wire and sibling seam remain inapplicable. Chief remains sole merger/closer.
